meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要用 Python 处理天文观测数据或天体物理数值计算。
copy.tagline_en: Compute astronomical data with units, coordinates, and FITS in Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with astronomical observations or astrophysics data in Python.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 写或调试天文 Python 代码时会调用 Astropy 接口:换算物理单位与量、转换天球坐标、读写 FITS 文件、操作表格与时间、做 WCS 与宇宙学计算。
howto.when: 当你要求写或调试使用 Astropy 的天文数据分析代码时会触发,例如坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学距离计算等。
